 UEFA Nations League: 2026-27 Nations League, schedule, standings, scores, format
 By
 Andy Edwards , 
 By
 Andy Edwards 
     Published November 14, 2026 06:30 PM 
 Facebook 
 Twitter 
 Email
 The UEFA Nations League 2026-27 tournament is front and center as Portugal aim to win the tournament for a third time. 
 MORE — AFCON qualifying | USMNT upcoming schedule 
 Portugal won it in 2019 and 2025, while France and Spain are the only other nations to win the Nations League. 
 Reigning World Cup champs Spain have lost twice in the final too, once to France and once to Portugal.
 UEFA Nations League past winners
 2018-19 : Portugal
 2020-21 : France
 2022-23 : Spain
 2024-25 : Portugal
 2026-27 UEFA Nations League format
 Four leagues — A, B, C and D — featuring relegation and promotion
 16 teams in Leagues A, B and C; six teams in League D
 Four groups of four teams, drawn from four pots, ranked by finish in 2024-25 Nations League
 Two teams qualify from each group for the quarterfinals
